fiscal_aggregate.weighting_rule: raw weight = sqrt(max(abs(target value), 1)); mean-normalized within amount/count value basis; each semantic concept group's total weight is scaled to its largest row weight; the amount and count bases are then scaled to equal total budget; the vector is mean-normalized; the aggregate is the weighted mean of per-target |actual - target| / max(|target|, 1), each capped at 100%

relative_error.rule: (actual - target) / target; when target is zero, the raw actual-minus-target delta
